resolutions.researcher_notes: Old ref (egyptoil-gas.com report, non-archived) was dead; recovered via Wayback (CDX confirms live snapshots through 2026-01-03, PDF, 200). url_verifier.py flags the Wayback PDF as 'missing expected: Obaiyed' — a false negative documented in url_verifier.py's own docstring (PDF text-extraction/ligature limitation); manually confirmed via pdftotext that the page IS live and contains 'Obaiyed Spurline', 'Obaiyed-Tarek', capacities/diameters etc. for the Western Desert gas network. Second, independent source: GASCO's own official site (gasco.com.eg, operator of the Western Desert Gas Complex/WDGC) states WDGC 'operation began in May 2000' and that 'feed gases reach the plant' from Al-Obaiyed (Badr El-Din Petroleum Co.) via a pipeline to the complex at Amreya -- confirms the corridor is an active, in-service gas trunk (status=operating by context; the literal word 'operating' need not appear per confidence_tiers.md). url_verifier.py SSL-failed on gasco.com.eg (Python SSLError on the cert chain -- same class of false negative as the documented pgjonline.com case); confirmed manually: `curl -sL -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://www.gasco.com.eg/index.php/gas-plants/` returns 200 and `curl -v` shows 'SSL certificate verify ok.' Both sources are independent (Egypt Oil & Gas trade publication vs. GASCO official corporate site) and neither traces to GEM. No contradiction on status.

Same Wayback-recovered egyptoil-gas.com report (dead original -> live archive.org snapshot, confirmed via pdftotext). Its 'Natural Gas Infrastructure in the Western Desert' pipeline table lists a row named exactly 'Obaiyed Spurline': From=Obaiyed, Length=41.5 km, Diameter=26 in, Capacity=480 mmcf/d -- an exact match to the GEM value (41.50 km). Could not find a second, independently-sourced figure for this specific 41.5 km segment: GASCO's own site (gasco.com.eg/index.php/gas-plants/) instead cites a *different* pipeline -- 'a pipeline of 34 inches in diameter and 230 km in length' carrying Al-Obaiyed-area gas to WDGC -- which lines up with the same table's separate 'Tarek-Ameryia' row (231 km, 34in), i.e. the network's main trunk, NOT the 41.5km 'Obaiyed Spurline' feeder. Flagging so this isn't later misread as a contradiction: the two length figures describe two different named segments in the same gas-gathering network, both consistent with each other and with GEM's segment naming. Only one qualifying source found for the 41.5 km figure itself -> tier=medium (single strong source), independent=false. class_out is still REFS_ADDED per this task's ref-cell scope (a working, value-supporting ref was found); the length itself is not in dispute.
